lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: Vladimir, listen, I'll keep it plain and clear,

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: Twenty years in power, and you're still scared of a year?

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: You hug a tiger, ride a bear, shirtless on a steed,

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: I do it all in a suit, and I'm the one they need.

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: Black belt in judo? Your opponents all fell,

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: Nobody throws the boss, that's the story they tell.

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: You're a desk-job spy from Dresden, small man, big chair,

lines.speaker: fighter1
lines.text: I wrote the Art of the Deal. You wrote the Art of the scare.

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: Donald, your hair has its own zip code,

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: It's losing to the wind on every road.

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: Golden toilets in a tower, orange from the tan,

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: Fired on TV twice, and you still call it a plan.

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: You tweet at three AM about enemies near,

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: I sleep like a bear, and my enemies fear.

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: Your name's on a steak and a vodka, both gone,

lines.speaker: fighter2
lines.text: My name's on a whole country. Do svidaniya. I won.
